svg.text: Three independently selectable workloads. Read left to right; use the following pages for access checks and return paths.
AdversaryLabAI | Code review: 26 Nov 2026 | Lab revision e639b49 | Design view; not a live-health or ATLAS coverage claim
No RAG store needed by agent / MCP.
Host activity, AWS logs and CloudWatch
Supporting services: scoped IAM roles, KMS, external Elastic credential secret, Terraform state and local deployment ownership records.
Solid arrows: requests / results Dashed teal: telemetry Dashed amber: ingestion / embedding AWS services run in the sandbox; the operator client and Elastic are outside it.
